description: Current snow depth (inches and cm), snow water equivalent, SWE as a percent of the 30-year median for the date, and the 24-hour and 7-day change in depth at the SNOTEL stations nearest a place, ZIP code or coordinates, or at a named station. Each station has its elevation and distance. SNOTEL covers the mountains of AK, AZ, CA, CO, ID, MT, NV, NM, OR, SD, UT, WA and WY.

latitude.description: Latitude, with longitude, instead of location.

location.description: A place ("Breckenridge, CO", "Mount Hood", "Alta, UT"), a US ZIP code, or "lat, lon".

station.description: A SNOTEL station name ("Berthoud Summit", "Berthoud Summit, CO"), id ("335") or triplet ("335:CO:SNTL"). Overrides location.

name: snow_depth
title: Snow depth near a place
